title: Positive-degree Zariski cohomology classes vanish locally
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme and let $\mathcal G$ be an abelian sheaf on the small Zariski site $X_{\rm Zar}$ [def-sc-zariski-site]. For an open $U\subseteq X$ let $\mathcal G|_U$ be the abelian sheaf $W\mapsto\mathcal G(W)$ ($W\subseteq U$ open) on $U_{\rm Zar}$. Let $\mathcal G\to\mathcal I^\bullet$ be any injective resolution of $\mathcal G$ in the abelian category $\textit{Ab}(X_{\rm Zar})$ [def-sp-injective-resolutions], [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], so that $H^q(X_{\rm Zar},\mathcal G)=H^q(\mathcal I^\bullet(X))$ [def-sc-zariski-cohomology]; by [lem-weil-pbc-zariski-open-restriction-injectives], $\mathcal G|_U\to\mathcal I^\bullet|_U$ is an injective resolution of $\mathcal G|_U$ in $\textit{Ab}(U_{\rm Zar})$ with $\Gamma(U,\mathcal I^\bullet|_U)=\mathcal I^\bullet(U)$, so $H^q(U_{\rm Zar},\mathcal G|_U)=H^q(\mathcal I^\bullet(U))$, and the restriction $\xi\mapsto\xi|_U$, $H^q(X_{\rm Zar},\mathcal G)\to H^q(U_{\rm Zar},\mathcal G|_U)$, is the map induced on $H^q$ by the morphism of complexes $\mathcal I^\bullet(X)\to\mathcal I^\bullet(U)$ given by the restriction maps of the sheaves $\mathcal I^p$. Then for every integer $q>0$, every class $\xi\in H^q(X_{\rm Zar},\mathcal G)$ and every point $x\in X$ there is an open neighbourhood $U\subseteq X$ of $x$ such that $\xi|_U=0$ in $H^q(U_{\rm Zar},\mathcal G|_U)$.

proof.text: A cocycle representative for ξ. Let A_U be the sheafified free abelian representable of an open U, as in def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology (2). The sheafification, free-forgetful and Yoneda adjunctions give Hom(A_U,F) ≃ F(U), naturally in U and F (private sectionEquiv and its proved naturality lemmas). Apply this to the terms and differentials of I. Mathlib InjectiveResolution.extMk defines the class of a section cocycle; extMk_surjective supplies a representative s for ξ with d(s)=0. The private zariski_resolution_cocycle_classes proves this comparison together with restriction compatibility and vanishing on boundaries, directly from Mathlib. No unproved bridge is assumed.

proof.text: Exactness and the kernel section. Write q=n+1. InjectiveResolution.exact_succ n gives exactness of I^n → I^{n+1} → I^{n+2}. In the private exact_sheaf_section_locally_boundary, map the kernel sequence of the second differential through sheafToPresheaf followed by evaluation at the top open. Preservation of kernels and ShortComplex.ab_exact_iff lift the cycle s to a section k of the kernel sheaf (lem-weil-pbc-sheafification-exact). ShortComplex.exact_iff_epi_kernel_lift makes the differential factored through this kernel an epimorphism (lem-weil-pbc-abelian-exact-iff-epi-kernel-lift).

source.place: Lemma 01FW proof: 'the complex I^bullet is exact in degree n. Hence Im(I^{n-1} -> I^n) = Ker(I^n -> I^{n+1}) as sheaves'

proof.text: Lift locally. Apply Sheaf.isLocallySurjective_iff_epi' to the kernel lift, using lem-weil-pbc-site-abelian-sheaf-epi-locally-surjective. Its image sieve on k is covering. Opens.mem_grothendieckTopology, the covering definition in def-sc-zariski-site, chooses an open U containing x and a section t of I^n(U). The factorization identity kernel.lift_ι and naturality of kernel.ι give d(t)=s|_U. This argument is fully proved in the private helper, with no new sorry.

source.place: Lemma 01FW proof: 'Since tilde xi is a section of the kernel sheaf over U we conclude there exists a covering {U_i -> U} of the site such that tilde xi|_{U_i} is the image under d of a section xi_i in I^{n-1}(U_i)'

proof.text: The restricted class is zero. Naturality of the differential shows s|_U remains a cocycle. The proved section/Hom comparison and InjectiveResolution.mk₀_comp_extMk identify the cohomologyPresheaf restriction of ξ with the class of s|_U. Since s|_U=d(t), InjectiveResolution.extMk_eq_zero_iff makes this class zero. This computes object cohomology over U in the original Zariski site and needs no restriction of I to the site of U, so lem-weil-pbc-zariski-open-restriction-injectives is not a proof dependency.

lean.statement: theorem zariski_cohomology_class_locally_zero {X : Scheme.{u}} [HasExt.{u} (Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u})] (G : Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u}) (I : InjectiveResolution G) (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) (ξ : (G.cohomologyPresheaf q).obj (op ⊤)) (x : X) : ∃ U : X.Opens, x ∈ U ∧ ((G.cohomologyPresheaf q).map (homOfLE (X := X.Opens) (x := U) (y := ⊤) le_top).op).hom ξ = 0
